title: SAT brings free mobile tax office to Nuevo Laredo Nov. 11–12, no appointment needed
excerpt: Mexico's tax agency brings its free Oficina Móvil to Nuevo Laredo on Nov. 11–12, with no appointment needed, at the UAT campus in Colonia Infonavit Fundadores.
content:
Mexico's Tax Administration Service, known as the SAT, will bring its free mobile tax office to Nuevo Laredo on Wednesday and Thursday, November 11 and 12, offering tax services with no appointment required, according to Semanario Balún Canán.

The Oficina Móvil will be set up at the Universidad Autónoma de Tamaulipas, Facultad de Comercio, Administración y Ciencias Sociales, on Calle Ayuntamiento Sur S/N in Colonia Infonavit Fundadores. Hours are 9:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. both days.

The visit is part of a five-day national deployment, November 9 through 13, bringing the mobile office to 48 municipalities in 24 states. The program aims to serve 8,595 people and complete 15,026 procedures, all free of charge and without a prior appointment. People can check module locations on the SAT portal.

The same deployment is also stopping elsewhere in Tamaulipas this week: in Aldama, November 9 through 13, on Calle Independencia No. 101 in Colonia Centro, and in Gustavo Díaz Ordaz, November 9 through 13, on Calle Segunda S/N in Colonia El Terrón, from 8:30 a.m. to 3:00 p.m.

Source: Semanario Balún Canán, November 9, 2026.
